bullets: Game 7 of 7 of the "8 BEST Cards in a SINGLE Deck" video (video t=1311-1514), a win over a Royal Giant / Hunter / Fisherman / Hero Berserker deck; Ryley labels the deck himself at the end — "Good game. Nice win. We played that super well, man. This bridge spam gameplay is beautiful" (t=1507-1512)

Defence is Cannon Cart plus a cheap spell: Cannon Cart on the Royal Giant (t=1345, t=1435.4, t=1467.5), Barbarian Barrel in the middle on the Hunter (t=1326), Zap on the support (t=1333, t=1367.4). At t=1467.5 the Cannon Cart goes centrally in front of the King Tower to cover a bridge Royal Giant in either lane

Offence is Evo Elite Barbarians at the bridge with Heal Spirit on top (t=1411.9 / t=1412.7) and Mother Witch behind (t=1416.4) — "if we just get one good sequence with the Earbs, we have a chance to win" (t=1398); the enemy right tower falls from 4858 to ~1300 HP from t=1422 onward

The Battle Ram is the opposite-lane punish while the Royal Giant is committed (t=1360.4, "battle ram at the bridge in the opposite lane"), and in overtime it is delayed out of Fireball range with a Barbarian Barrel tanking in front (t=1496-1502)
Goblinstein, being a Champion, sits out of cycle as insurance and then joins as a blocker for the Cannon Cart before the next Ebarbs cycle (t=1444-1450, t=1473.5)

new_deck.rationale: Battle Ram and Evo Elite Barbarians are dropped at the bridge the moment the opponent commits, with cheap Barbarian Barrel/Zap/Heal Spirit support rather than a tank-behind-king build-up; Ryley calls it "bridge spam gameplay" himself (t=1512).
new_deck.why_it_works_md: The deck answers a Royal Giant push with a single 5-elixir card (Cannon Cart) plus a 2-elixir spell, which leaves elixir over for an immediate bridge counter-push in the other lane. Evo Elite Barbarians are the win condition — Ryley plays the whole match around getting "one good sequence with the Earbs" (t=1398) — and Heal Spirit doubles as chip damage and a heal on that push, so a single 1-elixir card can swing a defence into an offence. Mother Witch behind the push is deliberately delayed so she survives the opponent's Fireball, and her Cursed Hogs can be steered with Zap. Goblinstein, as a Champion, stays out of the cycle as an emergency blocker and a tank for the Cannon Cart, which keeps the 4-card cycle fast enough to return to the Elite Barbarians.
